fact: The Ministry of Finance's 2026 budget allocation report for all organs of the State, covering 447 pages, was emitted from SIGFE on 19 December 2025.

Angola's public-administration ministry officially launched SINGERH, described as the new integrated human-resources system for the civil service, in Luanda, with its database already holding some 426,000 records transferred from SIGFE.

Angola's Ministry of Finance says audits cross-checked data from the newly launched civil service human resources system SINGERH against state payrolls, flagging more than 31,000 suspected ghost workers.
